assumptions.text: Consumers value discounts and perceive them as meaningful incentives to shop.
Time pressure increases consumer urgency and likelihood of immediate purchase.
Visa gift cards are recognized and trusted payment instruments among target customers.
Customers believe online information (e.g., Lowe's.com/rebates) is reliable and accessible.
The association between patriotic colors and holiday-themed products enhances appeal during national celebrations.
Promotions framed around patriotism (July 4th) resonate emotionally with American consumers.
Audiences understand the phrase 'while supplies last' as indicating scarcity and limited opportunity.
Customers expect retailers like Lowe's to provide clear instructions for claiming rebates.
Price sensitivity influences purchasing decisions, especially for home improvement items.
The brand message 'we help, you save' reflects a shared understanding of Lowe's role as a helpful, customer-focused retailer.
